name: Ranger
role: ranged striker and scout: hits either row, finds the traps and secrets
description: A bow, Leather and the sharpest eyes in the party. The Ranger shoots from the back row at any target in any row, and out of combat it makes the dungeon smaller: traps found, ambushes avoided, the next room scouted.

schools.name: Marksman
schools.philosophy: Aimed shots, Marks, either-row damage and first strike. The first arrow decides who the fight is about.

schools.name: Trapper
schools.philosophy: Traps, nets, snares and part-breaks. Decide where the enemy stands before you decide where to shoot.

schools.name: Pathfinder
schools.philosophy: Scouting, light, foraging, party Speed and ambush avoidance. Most fights are won in the corridor before them.

aiRuleDefault: IF self HP < 30% THEN item small hp potion on self; IF enemy status mark THEN aimed shot on marked enemy; ELSE hunters mark on strongest enemy

visual.notes: A hood point and a bow arc: tall and narrow, the bow's curve breaking the outline on one side and the quiver angled across the back on the other.

pros: Hits either row from the back row; kills a back-row spitter on turn one
Steady Draw: the party's first strike, every fight
Detection 12 at creation: traps, secrets, treasure and fewer ambushes
cons: Leather Defense: two front-row hits are a third of its HP
Arrows are consumed and cost gold; an empty quiver is a basic-attack Ranger
Falls apart if ambushed or once the front row falls
